target_definition: is_delayed = 1 if status=='Delayed' (delay_minutes > 90), real business ground truth
comparison_to_v1: v1 (139 trips, constructed target) had leakage issues and ~0.5 real AUC ceiling. v2 (1298 trips, real target+causal features) achieves genuine 0.65-0.73 AUC with no dominant/leaked feature - a materially more trustworthy and usable model.
known_limitations: Precision is modest (0.23) - expect meaningful false-positive rate in production alerts.
vehicles_master last_service_date was a single snapshot (not history) - excluded as invalid for 70% of trips.
Still single-snapshot master tables for driver/vehicle static attributes - a true SCD (slowly-changing dimension) history would improve accuracy further.
